digest.component_or_area: backend transport layer / core reconciler decoupling
propositions: Core reconciler modules currently construct AcliClient inline and import vendor-specific mappers directly, hardcoding Jira as the transport provider

Four transport-construction sites (applier._load_acli, fetcher._load_acli, run_differs outbound-diff client, _attestation.build_acli_client_from_env) must be routed through Backend.transport port to eliminate direct AcliClient instantiation
Provider-identity 'jira' literals in apply_inbound_records.py must be replaced with dynamic backend.vendor to decouple from hardcoded vendor names
apply_handlers.py must catch AssigneeNotFoundError via direct import rather than ctx.acli reference to maintain exception handling after transport abstraction
Behaviour-preservation verified by reconcile suite remaining green and neutrality gate confirming no direct AcliClient() calls remain in affected modules
